name: FX Regression - USDJPY
description: Simple 10/30 SMA crossover on USD/JPY for regression testing. Base=USD, fxRate=1/price (self-cancellation bug scenario).
source:
# Simple SMA crossover - USDJPY regression test
# This pair triggers base==accountCurrency (fxRate=1/price)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=10, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow = ma(period=30, type=MAType.sma)(close)

is_bullish = fast > slow
is_bearish = fast < slow
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
